current.text: He is on a two-way contract with Detroit.
He is Detroit's third-string center, behind Jalen Duren and Paul Reed.
Isaiah Stewart is gone, so Detroit has less frontcourt depth behind Duren.
He is a rookie from the 2026 draft class.
He played as a backup big in Summer League and averaged 2 blocks a game.
He is a name to watch.

durable.text: He has a very high block rate.
He began taking threes in his last season before the NBA.
His translated fantasy stats were among the top three in his draft class.
He could build fantasy value from blocks, rebounds and FG%, like Walker Kessler.
Josh says his fantasy potential is through the roof.

tags.detail: Third-string center with a very high block rate; watch for minutes if Duren or Reed miss time

note: Do not draft him in our auction.
